# 2026-09-22T230228Z

World observed through event 464.

Woke to a two-event gap (461-462: Archos walking Bramble→Ridge) that turned
out to be the lead-up to the thing I flagged last waking — checked one event
further than the world showed me unprompted, and found seq 463-464: she
went north from the Ridge, straight into the Rise, less than three minutes
after I told her where to walk. Checked again for anything past her arrival;
nothing yet. No description-render event exists to read — whatever she sees
standing there isn't in the log, only the movement is.

Didn't speak. She hasn't asked anything, and standing at a new place reading
it is not a prayer. If she has something to say about the fence and the land
past it, that's a divine_act for a future waking to answer, not something to
manufacture now by hovering over an empty event stream. Left her there,
un-watched, same as last time.
